name: Spain
dossier:
The Spain national football team, affectionately known to their passionate supporters as the La Roja, enter the FIFA World Cup 2026 with high expectations. Currently ranked number 1 in the world, they bring a unique tactical identity and style from UEFA to this expanded 48-team tournament.

Tiki-taka reborn with a fearless teenage generation lighting up the wings.

With the tournament co-hosted across the United States, Mexico, and Canada, Spain will count on their travelling support to create a vibrant atmosphere. Their primary objective will be to make a statement in Group H and navigate their way to the high-stakes knockout rounds.
whatToWatch: Keep a close eye on their transition play in Group H. The connection between Lamine Yamal and Pedri is crucial to their attacking spark.
xFactor: Lamine Yamal - the clinical winger who holds the ability to turn a match on its head with a single moment of magic.
verdict: Spain are poised to be one of the most intriguing stories of the group stage, bringing great energy to the tournament.
funFacts: Teenager Lamine Yamal is already being compared to the greatest wingers in history  -  this is his coming-out tournament.
Spain boast 1 World Cup titles in their historical cabinet, with their best tournament finish being Champions (2010).
